name: Omegaverse IRL?!
source:
Trey has a bit of an omegaverse obsession, which is definitely on his mind now that his transmasc husband, Ryan, is pregnant with their daughter Asa.  When Trey's anxieties about his love of ABO get the best of him, will he succumb to his worst fears?

[From [url=https://norbez.itch.io/omegaverse-irl]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
特雷（Trey）有一点对欧米伽宇宙的痴迷，现在他的跨马斯克丈夫瑞安（Ryan）怀上了他们的女儿阿莎（Asa），这肯定在他的脑海中。当特雷因对ABO的爱而感到焦虑时，他会屈服于最可怕的恐惧吗？
